data.name: Lycanthropy Corruption Stages

raw_tokens.value: Corruption Stage 0-You suffer no direct penalties due to your corruption as yet.
&nl;Corruption Stage 1-The first time you lose control, you kill defenseless small animals, such as birds, rodents, and possibly even a dog.
&nl;Corruption Stage 2-The second time this occurs, you kill larger animals, such as a horse, a cow, or a pig.

&nl;Corruption Stage 3-The third time this happens, you kill a nearby sentient humanoid, at which point the corruption becomes incurable and you are doomed to live a life of lycanthropy, forever turning evil and becoming an NPC under the GM's control.
